scope: Marriage chapter of Sarvartha Chintamani, online Sanskrit and interpretive commentary; not physical Bhasin pages

records.paraphrase: With Saturn strongly ruling the seventh and benefic/Jupiter aspects, describes spouse as charitable, religious and morally virtuous.
qualifiers: Spouse gender presumed female in historical text
Moral or religious values are not objective natal conclusions

records.paraphrase: Links seventh-house Rahu/Ketu or nodal condition with marital unfaithfulness and extreme danger to the husband, with separate malefic/krura-amsha conditions.
qualifiers: Printed sarāhuketo ... madane potentially read as Rahu AND Ketu occupying the seventh
Literal co-presence impossible under antipodal node convention
Exact Sanskrit syntax and alternate edition not yet collated
Gender-biased and threatening allegations cannot be made about any individual from astrology

records.paraphrase: Seventh lord near ascendant OR specified benefic near ascendant/seventh-associated sign is associated with marriage bālye, 'in childhood'.
qualifiers: Proximity sannihite and samīpa-rāśi must be operationalized
The source says childhood, not generally twenties or exact adult age
Historical child marriage must not be normalized as advice

records.paraphrase: Benefic, favorable varga and aspects involving ascendant, second and seventh houses/lord are associated with bālye marriage.
qualifiers: Conjunction vs disjunction not frozen
Vargha and 'benefic' definitions unresolved
No numeric age threshold

records.paraphrase: Seventh lord in Pārāvatāṃśa-or-higher division, strong second lord, and ascendant lord in gentle division associate with marriage in childhood.
qualifiers: Pārāvatāṃśa and mṛdu divisions require separately verified math
No numeric age threshold
Do not silently translate childhood as marriage in twenties

records.paraphrase: Various Venus/ascendant/second-house supports associated with favorable fortune after marriage.
qualifiers: VedicPupil flags ambiguous śukre'stage as seventh-house vs combust reading
Fortune not operationalized
Does not specify international migration or exact timing

records.paraphrase: Afflicted significator, seventh, second and ascendant lords are associated with significant deterioration of fortune through marriage.
qualifiers: Multiple adverse conditions and and/or remain unparsed
Opposite in valence to v62; do not score both automatically

records.paraphrase: Even after loss, favorable association/aspect may accompany later return of good fortune.
qualifiers: A repair/cancellation, not independent evidence of original loss
Timing undefined
Must not rescue an incorrect v63 prediction post hoc

records.paraphrase: Specified adverse seventh-lord/significator conditions lead to dūre vivāhāt; English site interprets fortune coming much later after marriage.
qualifiers: Sanskrit explicit temporal referent not fully certain without surrounding commentary
Do not relabel it 'late marriage' or 'late recovery' yet
Several alternative conditions require disambiguation

records.paraphrase: Further malefic placements/aspects lead to dūre vivāhāt, similarly rendered as late fortune after marriage by site.
qualifiers: Same lexical uncertainty as 6.65
May overlap 6.65, so correlated not independent

records.paraphrase: Tells reader to consider similar method for sons and other matters.
qualifiers: Methodological instruction, not an independent quantified prediction
Cannot convert wealth or marriage outcomes into a child outcome without source-specified mechanics

source_id_caveat: JYOT-SC-BHASIN identifies owner source family; online VedicPupil verse numbering/text not assumed textually identical to Bhasin translation; no chapter-level collation yet
